review:
Ice Ice Yeti is a slot whose reel area starts partly covered by ice blocks. Yeti Shake can trigger on any spin, breaking two to ten blocks to open up the grid. The Yeti Wild roars to break two or three blocks and award a respin, during which winning symbols stay put.

Nolimit rates it High volatility, with an 8,820x cap. It's a neat grid-expansion idea from the studio's early days, with charming cartoon art.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
